subject: Re: Redwood GitHub integration — quick demo & webhook questions
messages:
From: Laura Gomez <laura@openrepo.org>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in GitHub integration for OpenRepo runner

Hi Rachel —

I signed up for a trial yesterday and poked around the dashboard. My team at OpenRepo is evaluating Redwood to replace a home-grown bridge we use to surface CI logs and artifact metadata into our project dashboards.

A few quick questions before we book a demo:
- Is Redwood's GitHub integration compatible with self-hosted runners and GitHub Enterprise Server?
- What OAuth scopes or webhook permissions do we need to grant for the standard integration?
- We have strict firewall egress rules — can you share a short checklist of IPs/ports your service needs?

I'm in PST. We're a small engineering team (3 infra, 2 backend) and we'd like a short, technical demo that covers the webhook flow and auth model. Happy for a 30-min sync next week.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Gomez
Platform Engineer, OpenRepo
laura@openrepo.org
[attachment: deployment-checklist.md (text/plain)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Gomez <laura@openrepo.org>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in GitHub integration for OpenRepo runner

Thanks for the note and welcome to Redwood, Laura — great to hear you already started the trial. I can cover the high-level auth model and webhook flow; I'll loop in Aditya (SDR) to find a slot that fits your team.

Quick answers up front:
- Yes — we support self-hosted runners and GitHub Enterprise Server. There are a couple of optional integration paths depending on whether you want webhook-only or a deeper repo-scoped sync.
- Typical scopes: repo (read/write depending on feature set), admin:repo_hook or repo:hooks for webhook management, and optionally workflow if you want Actions-level data. We'll confirm exact scopes for your chosen flow.
- Firewall checklist: we can provide a short allowlist for outbound to our ingestion endpoints (HTTPS over 443). I'll attach a brief agenda and a one-page checklist for the call.

Would any of these times work for a 30-min technical demo (PST):
- Tue 14 Mar, 10:00–10:30am PST
- Tue 14 Mar, 2:30–3:00pm PST
- Wed 15 Mar, 9:00–9:30am PST

If none work, here's a Calendly link Aditya shared so you can pick a slot directly: https://calendly.com/redwood-sdrcalls/30min

Agenda (attach):
- 5m intro + goals
- 15m demo: webhook flow, auth, permissions
- 5m deployment checklist (firewall, tokens)
- 5m next steps 

I've attached a short demo agenda PDF for your team. If you can confirm which integration path you prefer (webhook-only vs repo sync) that will help us tailor the demo.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
rachel@redwoodinference.com
[attachment: demo-agenda-openrepo.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks — 14 Mar at 10:00am PST works for us. Please send the invite to laura@openrepo.org and cc dev-team@openrepo.org.

We'll aim to have one infra engineer on the call (Michael) and one backend engineer (Sanjay).

Quick requests before the demo:
- Can you record the session and share the recording?
- Please include the deployment checklist (firewall + required outbound endpoints) so our SRE can pre-clear it with security.
- If possible, share an example webhook payload that the Redwood ingestion expects (so we can cross-check with our payload schema).

Thanks again,
Laura

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Gomez <laura@openrepo.org>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Mar 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in GitHub integration for OpenRepo runner

Hi Laura — Marissa on the SE team, I'll be running the technical portion of the demo. A few items to help me prepare and make the 30 minutes high-value:

Please share before the call if possible:
- A sample webhook payload (JSON) or a link to a public repo with a sample payload.
- Whether you're on GitHub.com with self-hosted runners or GitHub Enterprise Server behind a firewall (you mentioned strict egress).
- Any non-standard workflow fields you expect us to preserve (artifact ids, custom metadata).

Pre-call prep we'll provide:
- Short example webhook payloads that show the fields we consume (attached as technical-spec-request.txt).
- A one-page firewall allowlist (we sent the demo agenda earlier and will include the checklist again in the invite).

If you prefer, we can also open a temporary read-only token for one repo during the demo so we can show the live wiring (you can revoke it immediately afterwards). Let me know if that's an option.

On the call we'll cover:
- End-to-end webhook ingestion and mapping
- Options for repo-scoped sync vs webhook-only (tradeoffs)
- Deployment checklist and firewall egress details

Looking forward to it — I've penciled in Tue 14 Mar 10:00am PST. Calendar invite coming from Rachel/Aditya with the recording enabled.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
